The Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) in Cross River State says at least nine people died following a single-vehicle crash at the Yahe Bridge area of the state on Wednesday.
Pascal Anigbo, the commander of the FRSC Unit in Yahe, told the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) that the accident involved a DAF truck with registration number GAS706XA.
Mr Anigbo said the truck carrying 85 people crashed due to speeding and loss of control by the driver.
“The driver tried to avoid a head-on collision with another truck coming from the opposite direction, so the truck veered off the road into the bush,” he said.
He said 46 people were injured in the incident while 30 others were unhurt.
Mr Anigbo said the FRSC officials worked with some soldiers to conduct rescue operations.
“We have evacuated those injured to a hospital for treatment.

“Three bodies were deposited at the mortuary after a doctor confirmed them dead, while six others were taken away after being identified,” he said.
The FRSC official further said the truck was also carrying palm oil, refrigerators, motorbikes, and other items.
